//: yen's own code. Excludes the routes that import @4eye/web, because TS would otherwise load that package's pre-existing errors into this project. Exclusion only works when nothing else in the program imports the excluded file — so anything importing that package has to live beside its own route rather than in src/components.
//2: src/app/integration-layer is excluded for the same reason as src/app/4eye: LayerModes renders the real IntegrationLayersTile. Its ladder half stays in src/components/layers and is still checked here.
//3: One file from that package is in scope deliberately: src/components/crown imports Tiles/integration-layers/goals/LiquidCrown for the flat crown, rather than keeping a second copy of the same drawing here. It is a leaf — Box and one icon — and it typechecks clean. Verify with `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.strict.json | grep 4eye-web-mockup`; if that ever returns more than LiquidCrown.tsx, the import has grown a tail and should be reconsidered.
